decisions.reason: Although the accelerator is less central than machinery, its homepage visibility and fit with the firm's partnership-led circular-growth narrative make management likely to continue it for now.
The bio-based binder is more peripheral to the core plant business and thus somewhat more at risk, but the firm's R&D orientation and sustainability commitment still favor giving it more time.
This prominently launched decontamination plant is close to the firm's waste-treatment capabilities and carries visible public commitment, so management is unlikely to withdraw it quickly.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant sits squarely in the firm's announced strategy of decentralized recycling infrastructure, making it the least likely product to be taken off the market.
